paite: Huan api Naomi, apasal nu'n akiang ah, "Ka tanu, nang a ding in khawlna ka hon zonsak kei dia hia, huchi in nang a ding in ahoih ding hi.
heading: Ruth In Pasal Amu

paite: I tanaupa Boaz, asikha nungakte toh nna na sepna pa om hilou hia? Ngai in, tuzan in phual ah barli buh azapsiang ding hi.
Huchi in kisil inla, thau kinilh inla, na kizepna puan silh inla, phual ah va hohsuk in. Himahleh an ne a, adawn khit masiah akiang ah kitheisak ke'n.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, alup chiang in alupna chiamteh inla, lut inla, akhe lem inla, va lum in. Ama'n na hih ding ahon hilh ding," achi hi.
Ama'n akiang ah, "Na gen teng ka hih ding," achi hi.
Huchi in phual ah ahohsuk a, api hilh bang in ava hihta hi.
Boaz in an ne a, adawn khit in alungtang akipak a, buhvum bul a lum ding in apaita a, huan, minu leng awlawl in ahong pai a, akhe alem a, alumta hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, akhe kiang ah numei khat ana lumta mai a, zan lai in huai mipa kiguih in akihei hi.
Ama'n, "Kua na hia?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na sikhanu Ruth ka hi. Huchi in na sikhanu na puan hon zawn in, ka tanau bul lah na hi ngal a," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka tanu, TOUPA'N nang hon vualzawl hen. Tangval zawng hiam, hausa hiam na zuih louh in atung lai sang in anunglam ah hoihna na hihlang zaw hi.
Huchi in ka tanu, lau ke'n. Na gen bang in na tung ah ka hih ding. I khua a mi tengteng in numei kizentak na hi chih athei vek ngal ua.
Kitanau nai i hi ngut hi. Himahleh kei sang a naizaw a-om hi.

Tuzan zaw om peuhmah inla, zingchiang zingsang in na tung a ama'n atanau hih ding ahihnopleh ahoih hi. Himahleh tanau hih ding na tung a ahihnop keileh, tanau hih ding pen TOUPA ahin bang in ke'n ka hih ding. Zingsang tan lum nilouh in,” achi hi.
Huchi in zingsang tan in akhebul ah alum hi. Kuamah akimuh chet theih ma in athoukhia hi. Ama'n, "Phual ah numei a hong chih himhim kuamah in thei kei hen," achi hi.
Akiang ah, "Na puansilh la inla, doh in," achi hi. Huchi in adoh a, barli buh tehna guk atehsak a, asuan a; huchi in khua ah apaita hi.
Api kiang atun in, "Ka tanu, bang na hong chi a?" ana chi hi. Ama'n, huai mipa in atung a thil ana hih tengteng ahilhta hi.
"Hiai barli buh tehna guk ahon pia a, 'na pi kiang ah avuak in pai ke'n,' ahon chi," achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka tanu, bangchibang in ahia thil ahong om ding na theih ma in tu maimai in. Tuni a hiai thil ahih khit mateng huai mipa dai mai lou ding ahi," achi hi.
